title: Publish RenderGraph test binary paths for queued targeted witnesses
body: The first queued baseline invocation used build/wsl/VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph/tests/test_rendergraph_core and failed exit 127. The working path was build/wsl/libraries/RenderGraph/tests/test_rendergraph_core. A generated test launcher or documented target-to-binary map should remove this manual path discovery.

title: VIXEN standalone configuration should select provider mode when UNDERTOW_ROOT is absent
body: The documented standalone configure failed at Text because UNDERTOW_ROOT was absent and VIXEN_RENDERER_PROVIDER_MODE was not selected. Failed: cmake -S VIXEN --preset vixen-wsl -DVIXEN_WITH_FSR3=OFF. Workaround: add -DVIXEN_RENDERER_PROVIDER_MODE=ON and the local kernel SHA override. Provider ownership should be derived by the build facade.
